tasks.label: Install library
tasks.command: if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then sudo npm install && sudo npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps; else npm install && npm ci && npx playwright install; fi

tasks.label: Run test cases of ui - chromium
Run test cases of ui - firefox
Run Gherkin E2E tests by file or tag
tasks.command: ENV=${input:env_gherkin} BROWSER=${input:browser_gherkin} npx cucumber-js ${input:gherkin_file_or_tag} --require tests/gherkin/register-ts.js --require tests/gherkin/step_definitions/e2e/hooks.ts --require tests/gherkin/step_definitions/e2e/common.steps.ts --require tests/gherkin/step_definitions/e2e/cart.steps.ts --require tests/gherkin/step_definitions/e2e/orders.steps.ts --format progress-bar --format pretty --format summary --format json:tests/gherkin/cucumber-report.json --format html:tests/gherkin/cucumber-report.html

tasks.label: Run Gherkin API tests by file or tag
tasks.command: ENV=${input:env_gherkin} npx cucumber-js ${input:gherkin_file_or_tag} --require tests/gherkin/register-ts.js --require tests/gherkin/step_definitions/api/common.steps.ts --format progress-bar --format pretty --format summary --format json:tests/gherkin/cucumber-report.json --format html:tests/gherkin/cucumber-report.html

tasks.label: View allure report
tasks.command: if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then sudo npm cache clean --force && npx allure generate allure-results -o allure-report && npx allure open allure-report; else npm cache clean --force && npx allure generate allure-results -o allure-report && npx allure open allure-report; fi

tasks.label: Install K6
tasks.command: sudo chown -R admin /opt/homebrew && brew install k6
